title: Sales Executive

schemaDescription: Join Myntmore as a Sales Executive in BKC, Mumbai. Lead end-to-end sales for executive personal branding and B2B growth services. Rs 4–7 LPA.
aboutIntro: We're looking for a hungry, confident, and articulate Sales Executive to drive revenue for our executive personal branding and outbound lead generation services. You'll connect with high-level executives, startup founders, consultants, doctors, and professionals, helping them understand how personal branding and outbound pipelines unlock revenue for their businesses.

responsibilities.title: Find the Stars
responsibilities.desc: Identify and connect with potential clients, including high-level executives, startup founders, doctors, lawyers, and more. Help them unlock the power of personal branding with Myntmore.

responsibilities.title: Master the CRM Game
responsibilities.desc: Take charge of managing our CRM system, keeping it organised and up to date with valuable insights. Play a key role in streamlining our sales process and ensuring everything runs smoothly.

responsibilities.title: Seal the Deal
responsibilities.desc: Lead prospects through the sales funnel, from the initial conversation all the way to a successful close. Confidently communicate our value proposition and build genuine, lasting client relationships.

responsibilities.title: Stay Ahead of the Curve
responsibilities.desc: Keep a pulse on industry trends and competitor strategies, bringing fresh ideas to the table. Help us continuously refine our sales tactics and position Myntmore at the top of the market.

responsibilities.title: Be the Voice of Myntmore
responsibilities.desc: Represent the brand with energy, professionalism, and passion across every call and interaction. Leave a positive, lasting impression on every prospect you speak with.

whoYouAre.label: Proven Track Record

whoYouAre.label: Strong Communicator
whoYouAre.desc: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to connect with senior leaders

whoYouAre.label: CRM Fluent
whoYouAre.desc: Experience with Zoho CRM, HubSpot, or similar sales platforms

whoYouAre.label: Goal-Oriented
whoYouAre.desc: Self-driven, competitive, and motivated by closing deals and exceeding targets

whoYouAre.label: Active Listener
whoYouAre.desc: Ability to listen deeply, understand client pain points, and position solutions effectively

whoYouAre.label: Adaptable
whoYouAre.desc: Comfortable in a fast-paced agency environment where every day brings different prospects and challenges

whoYouAre.label: Professional Presence
whoYouAre.desc: A polished, confident demeanour when speaking with C-level executives and business owners

whoYouAre.label: Continuous Learner
whoYouAre.desc: Curious, open to feedback, and always looking to sharpen your sales craft

whyJoin: Sell a high-demand service that delivers measurable ROI for founders and executives. Work from WeWork Enam Sambhav, BKC with an ambitious team, direct access to leadership, and attractive incentives on closed deals.
